eq-ch05-conditions-residual: Reaction equilibrium, the weighted sum of chemical potentials equal to zero, written as one residual per reaction; checked by `derivation-checks/check_ch5_equilibrium.py`, line a (vapour-liquid closed form).
eq-ch05-newton-jacobian: Differentiating the residual in the reaction extents gives the Jacobian; checked against kintera's returned gain by `derivation-checks/check_ch5_equilibrium.py`, line d (0.0 relative), and against central differences, line b; it is singular when there are more phases than independent elements, line f.
eq-ch05-newton-bounds: The amounts after a scaled step must stay above `mole-floor`; the slack stays positive, so the floor acts in the line search, not in the direction; checked by `derivation-checks/check_ch5_equilibrium.py`, line e.
eq-ch05-log-k-gibbs: The NASA-9 Gibbs energies give the dimensionless constant; checked by `derivation-checks/check_ch5_equilibrium.py`, line c (independent table parse).
eq-ch05-log-k-vant-hoff: Gibbs–Helmholtz on the NASA-9 forms gives the van 't Hoff equation $\mathrm d\ln K^\circ_r/\mathrm dT = \Delta_r h^\circ/(\mathcal R T^2)$; checked by `derivation-checks/check_ch5_equilibrium.py`, line c.
